observations: Photo 0 shows a black standing fan with a circular grille, five blades, and a black base. The fan is positioned against a white wall with a visible power cord extending to the floor.
Photo 1 shows the same fan from a slightly different angle, with the brand name 'QASA' visible on the center hub of the fan head.
The fan appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and wear on the base and grille.
No visible damage to the blades or motor housing.
The power cord is intact and appears to be standard length.

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: Brand 'QASA' is visible on the fan head in photo 1; the item is clearly a standing fan.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low.
claims.evidence: No photo or video shows the fan in operation or battery status. The claim cannot be verified from still images.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The fan may not be rechargeable as claimed.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan being powered on and off, or a photo of the battery compartment and charging port.

risks.risk: The fan may not work or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running at different speeds and a close-up of the motor and blades.

risks.risk: The fan may have hidden damage to the motor or wiring.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the motor housing and power cord connection point.

proof_requests: Video of the fan running at different speeds.
Photo of the battery compartment and charging port.
Close-up of the motor and power cord connection point.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
